title: Helm hook timing safeguard and tenant rollback automation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary:
During recent Private/VPC rolling upgrades several tenants experienced prolonged reconcile stalls and request failures caused by out-of-order Helm post-upgrade hooks and finalizer interactions. Two customers escalated after automated upgrade wave applied concurrent Helm releases which triggered operator leader election churn and left tenant CRs in a partial state (webhook/MutatingWebhookDeferred handlers saw missing secrets).

Root cause hypothesis:
- Helm hook ordering + parallel release propagation allowed post-upgrade hooks (post-install/post-upgrade) to run before dependent secrets and CRD projections were reconciled across all namespaces.
- Operator reconcile loop assumed idempotent resource projection; in practice finalizer presence + missing secret annotations caused early exit and prevented resumption.
- Race between nodeagent bootstrap and manifest apply in onprem environments caused transient webhook failures that left tenant manifests with semantically different hashes (config drift).

Goals for this ticket:
1) Implement a helm-hook timing safeguard in the operator preflight to detect and delay post-upgrade hook execution when dependent resources (Secrets/ExternalSecrets/CRDs) are unresolved cluster-wide.
2) Add an automated tenant rollback/evacuation automation (safe drain + rollback) that can be invoked by support/oncall for affected customers.
3) Publish a targeted runbook and automated remediation Playbook that reduces customer downtime to < 15 minutes for similar incidents.

Work to be delivered:
- Operator change: preflight hook gating (operator will check a configured predicate across tenant namespaces and hold hook completion until predicate satisfied or timeout).
- Helm chart helper: add pre-hook job template that annotates release with dependency readiness checks.
- Rollback automation: kubectl-compatible script + operator API endpoint to perform tenant evacuation (scale-to-zero, snapshot CR state, rollback helm release, resume).
- Tests: integration test that simulates parallel helm releases across 30 tenant namespaces and asserts no reconcile stalls; e2e in onprem staging (vSphere) with artificial webhook delay.
- Runbook and customer communication templates for escalations.

Non-goals:
- Rewriting Helm release controller. This is a targeted safeguard and runbook-based remediation path only.
comments: 2025-03-11 - MC: Initial ticket created after oncall call with Customer A and B. Logged error samples and kube-events. Added high priority.

2025-03-11 - AP: Investigated logs; found operator loop exited early due to finalizer check + missing secret annotation. Captured stacktraces and added to attachments. Marked urgent and started local repro.
2025-03-11 - AP: Repro steps committed to test-repro branch. Repro uses 20 parallel helm installs with randomized hook timing. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/14567

2025-03-12 - EK (SRE): Confirmed two customer clusters showed identical event pattern: helm post-upgrade job succeeded on control plane but worker nodeagent had not yet registered secrets. Suggested adding a 30s leader-election jitter and pre-hook readiness probe.

2025-03-12 - AP: Drafted operator preflight gating change and unit tests. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/14592 for internal review. Will wire CI integration tests after initial review.
2025-03-12 - PM (L. Torres): Coordinating customer comms. Draft status sent to Customer A; they requested the ability to trigger immediate rollback via support console. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-12 - Design (R. Gupta): Reviewed UX for 'Initiate Tenant Evacuation' button in the Console. Proposed confirmation modal and progress stream. UX doc: https://drive.redwood.com/design/evacuation-ux-v1

2025-03-12 - AP: Establishing runbook draft and short-circuit remediation: operator-api POST /v1/tenants/<id>/evacuate triggers snapshot + rollback. Implementation scoped to operator-4.9.2 patch release.
acceptance_criteria: Operator preflight gating implemented and covered by unit tests (gate toggled by config flag).
Integration test verifies no reconcile stalls with 30 parallel helm releases in staging cluster.
Rollback/evacuation automation can be invoked from operator API and documented in runbook.
Runbook validated in a tabletop with SRE, Support, and one customer-facing SE; customer-facing comms templates approved by PM.
Patch released to operator-4.9.2 and deployed to staging; rollout plan created for customer opt-in in Private clusters.
